// Included only in the hosted test executable. Pairing and these signed
// requests use the same Machine executable in its throwaway default Keychain.
package daemon

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"os/signal"
	"os/user"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func RunHostedUpgradeFixture(fp string) error {
	refused := errors.New("not the disposable hosted service-upgrade fixture")
	if os.Getenv("GITHUB_ACTIONS") != "true" || os.Getenv("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") != "github-hosted" || os.Getenv("MM_KEYD_CUSTODY_TEST") != "1" || os.Getuid() == 0 || os.Getuid() != os.Geteuid() {
		return refused
	}
	bin, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	stage := filepath.Dir(bin)
	parent := filepath.Dir(stage)
	if filepath.Dir(parent) != "/Library" || !strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Base(parent), "hq-install-ci.") || filepath.Base(stage) != "upgrade-provider" {
		return refused
	}
	current, err := exec.Command("/usr/bin/security", "default-keychain", "-d", "user").Output()
	db := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(string(current)), "\"")
	if err != nil || filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(db)) != "/private/tmp" || !strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(db)), "mm-native-keychain.") || filepath.Base(db) != "fixture.keychain-db" {
		return refused
	}
	if len(fp) != 64 || SocketListening(ChannelSocket()) {
		return refused
	}
	u, err := user.Current()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	key, err := serviceKey(u.HomeDir, fp)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer zeroBytes(key)
	dir := stateDir(u.HomeDir)
	pairing, err := loadPairing(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ln, err := listenForRun(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer ln.Close()
	ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer cancel()
	provider := func(ctx context.Context, home string, d deviceDelegation) ([]byte, error) {
		raw, err := json.Marshal(d)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, filepath.Join(stage, "agent-bot-keyd"), "hq-device")
		cmd.Dir = "/"
		cmd.Env = []string{"PATH=/usr/bin:/bin", "HOME=" + home}
		cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(append(raw, '\n'))
		var out keydOutput
		cmd.Stdout = &out
		if err = cmd.Run(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return out.buf.Bytes(), nil
	}
	hooks := Hooks{
		Status:       func() (string, []byte, error) { return statusBody(dir) },
		MembersPlans: func(option, id string) ([]byte, error) { return readMembersPlans(u.HomeDir, option, id) },
		HQDevice:     func(r Request) Response { return requestHQDevice(ctx, u.HomeDir, key, r, time.Now, provider) },
		ServiceRecovery: func(r Request) Response {
			return recoverHQService(dir, key.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey), r, time.Now, func(id, digest string, uid int) (string, error) {
				return currentPairedServicePlan(r.Verb, u.HomeDir, u.Username, id, digest, uid)
			})
		},
	}
	err = Serve(ctx, ln, &Gate{Dir: dir, Pairing: pairing}, key, peerCred, hooks)
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return nil
	}
	return err
}
